contract: Every listed obligation is required for its exact operation; collect its substantive receipt at kc-domain-checks. Evidence is prepared at kc-qualify-evidence. Impact and terminal rules are the corresponding sections of each pinned profile method and are enforced at kc-impact-plan and kc-review-reconcile. No discretionary not_applicable waiver exists in this version. General composes with every selected profile.

obligations.requirement: Trace each material assertion to exact evidence and preserve source authority, scope, epistemic state, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty and freshness.
Establish a new semantic identity or exact duplicate disposition, complete meaning, applicability, ownership and composed profiles without conflicting domain copies.
Explain the lossless semantic diff against the accepted revision, including modality, conditions, exceptions, authority, applicability, profile changes and any explicit reactivation.
Show new suitable evidence for unchanged meaning and authority; reject timestamp-only renewal and route semantic changes to revise.
Prove eligible noncyclic successor coverage for the exact enumerated replacement bindings and material conditions, retaining uncovered and pinned consumer obligations.
Establish withdrawal identity, scope, current authority and reason; distinguish historical retention and consumer gaps from deletion or repaired downstream work.
Establish authorized payload ownership, exact copy/shared-source scope and retention boundaries; do not treat hidden triples as full payload or backup erasure.
Qualify environment fit, prerequisites, authority and dated proof; keep documented, static and runtime verification distinct and exclude secret parameter values.
Provide ordered usable steps with expected results, verification, preflight, stops, failure/recovery and proof for the declared target and authority.
Trace changed steps, parameters, dependencies, authority and recovery to invalidated downstream behavior and proof; preserve only compatible prior evidence.
Recheck unchanged operational fit with new suitable evidence in the exact environment; do not claim runtime validation from a document reread.
Compare successor eligibility, parameters, results, authority, recovery and proof level for each replaced binding; preserve transition and pinned execution needs.
Identify unsafe or unsupported use and affected operations without claiming external execution was stopped or rolled back.
Identify owned recipes, parameter examples, execution evidence and derivative copies; separate unrelated operational records and any credential-rotation follow-up.
Pin specification version and provider/network scope; distinguish declared contracts, observed behavior, capability limits, negative states and conflicting evidence.
Represent versioned contract, capabilities, compatibility, invariants and failure/quirk scope without generalizing provider observations.
Explain contract/schema/version and compatibility changes, affected integrations and invalidated observations; distinguish corrected interpretation from upstream change.
Use new suitable authoritative and provider-specific evidence for unchanged scoped meaning; do not call saved-response replay fresh observation.
Show successor coverage of capabilities, compatibility and negative behavior for each replaced integration binding, retaining uncovered legacy needs.
Withdraw the scoped unsupported assertion and identify dependent integration gaps without claiming deployed integrations changed.
Identify owned specification/response fragments, observations and derived summaries while preserving independently owned shared protocol sources.
Establish exact asset/environment identity, source authority, custody and dated observation scope; distinguish declared topology/configuration from observed deployed state and health.
Represent bounded asset/topology, ownership, configuration references, deployment surfaces and observation limits without copying secrets or inferring runtime health.
Trace asset/configuration/topology/ownership changes and corrected documentation to affected dependencies, stale observations and preserved identity history.
Use new suitable observations for the unchanged assertion and exact environment; preserve reachability/authority gaps and route changed topology meaning to revise.
Compare successor topology role, scope, ownership and custody; enumerate migration dependencies without claiming cutover, data migration or decommissioning occurred.
Withdraw unreliable infrastructure assertions and expose consumer gaps without changing or shutting down resources.
Inventory owned asset notes, configuration snapshots, observations and topology derivatives; preserve unrelated resources and separately own rotation/decommissioning actions.
Establish operating authority, owners, role/cadence/handoff/status meaning and metric definitions; distinguish agreed rules, proposals and observed practice.
Describe usable trigger/input, responsibility, output, cadence, handoff, escalation, metrics and exceptions with explicit ownership gaps instead of invented organizational facts.
Trace changed responsibilities, status/cadence, metrics and exceptions to affected consumers while preserving historical metric interpretation and adoption limits.
Use new suitable evidence that unchanged authority, owners, cadence and signal sources remain applicable; actual-practice assertions need dated practice evidence.
Compare successor purpose, responsibilities, handoffs, metrics and exception coverage; retain transition ownership, unresolved commitments and old metric meaning.
Withdraw the scoped model and identify unsupported handoffs without claiming external commitments, incidents or notifications were handled.
Identify owned model text, role/source examples, metric snapshots and derivatives while preserving unrelated operational and independently retained records.
Map the question and segment/context to real observations, reports, inferences and synthetic material with sample/time limits, assumptions and negative evidence.
Trace conclusions, decisions or hypotheses to evidence and alternatives, preserving synthetic-vs-real distinction and proposal status for product/Program suggestions.
Explain changed evidence, assumptions, segments or reasoning and affected decisions without upgrading hypotheses or erasing disconfirming history by omission.
Use new suitable evidence for the unchanged bounded assertion; synthetic reruns and old reports do not become fresh customer evidence.
Compare question/segment, evidence quality, assumptions and conclusion coverage for replaced bindings while retaining negative evidence and competing explanations.
Withdraw the unsupported assertion/recommendation and identify dependent assumptions without changing a roadmap or Program automatically.
Inventory owned interviews, excerpts, analysis, synthetic outputs and derivatives with explicit shared-source and independent-decision-record boundaries.
Map scoped assets/boundaries, threats and controls to authority and verification evidence; preserve sensitivity/access, exceptions, residual risk and separate finding/remediation status.
Represent supported control coverage and gaps without treating proposals, configurations or closed findings as verified effectiveness; restricted evidence must remain OwnersOnly or unavailable.
Trace changed boundaries, controls, authority, sensitivity, exceptions or status to invalidated proof and mappings without silently weakening access or risk obligations.
Use new suitable evidence for unchanged asset/boundary assertions; an old scan, unchanged document or closed issue cannot establish current effectiveness.
Compare successor scope, control coverage, authority, exceptions, sensitivity and verification; preserve uncovered threats and prevent silent weakening for replaced bindings.
Withdraw unsupported security guidance and expose dependent gaps without claiming a control was disabled, vulnerability remediated or finding closed.
Inventory restricted owned evidence, findings and derivative/replay copies without reproducing their payload; resolve retention scope and separate remediation/rotation authority.
